info.title: Urja Meter API
info.description:
REST API over the **Urja Meter Ops** portal. The service signs in to the portal with
server-side credentials, reads smart-meter data the same way the portal's own web UI
does, and returns it as consistent JSON. It never changes anything on the portal.

All errors use one shape: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}`.

get.description: Always cheap: does not contact the portal.
Signs in to the portal if needed and runs one lightweight search request.
Meters sorted by ID. Filters are exact and case-insensitive (``q`` is a substring match).

schema.description: Substring of meter ID or serial number.

get.description:
Register readings from the portal, oldest first.

Without dates the portal returns its default window: the last 7 days of available data.
With only ``from`` it returns 7 days starting there; with only ``to``, 7 days ending there.
